label: Which creature fills the Forge's slow-ground slot?

LavaSnail.why: agent lean: ties to the alloys line, warns of melt-back, strongest silhouette
LavaSnail.context: Kettugal: a ceramic bowl of glowing slag on six legs; the first thing to walk off the crust before melt-back; sheared for alloy. Ummisk: a steaming tussock of glassy tubes that drinks the boiling rain and leaves a walkable glass trail over lava edges. Brazzok: a tall living kiln-chimney on stilts streaming a steam banner; herds read as towers. Full brief: design/RimMandrake/forge_slowground_concepts_2026-10-20.md
